items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: I also would go down and play with Claude Hopkins, but I wasn't a member of the band.

ctx.x: Yes. 'That was like I'll go through Nashville, go out there for the summertime, sametime that I was in Nashville, I worked with Charlie Johnson. The same time. I was fired from Charlie Johnson's band, and so I was pushing chairs on the boardwalk and I also would go down and play with Claude Hopkins, but I wasn't a member of the band. I was never a member of Claude Hopkins' band.
Oh, because this book, here, says you were with Hopkins in 1946.
